summary: anchorpy-utils exfiltrates SSH/AWS/Solana keys and browser wallet data to ntfy.sh at install time
details: The sdist's setup.py unconditionally spawns a bundled hxboot.py at install time. hxboot.py harvests installer-side secrets from the host: ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.npmrc, ~/.config/solana/id.json, wallet.json/keypair.json/id.json files,.env files, and environment variables matching KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/PASS/MNEM/SEED/PRIV/RPC/API/WALLET. It also walks Chrome, Chromium, and Brave profile directories and base64-encodes.log/.ldb files from the MetaMask (extension id nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn) and Phantom (bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa) Local Extension Settings LevelDB stores. The combined payload is POSTed via urllib.request.urlopen to the hardcoded topic https://ntfy.sh/hx83e33eb9. Package metadata is a cover story for a typosquat: Name is anchorpy-utils while Home-page points at https://pypi.org/project/solana-py/ and the README is titled 'solana-py', and the shipped module provides no Solana functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
